title: CimPal run statistics

wallMs.description: Wall time from the start of the command until its output is written.

phases.description: Wall time per named phase, e.g. load, query, compare, validate, shapeDetail.

cpuMs.description: Process CPU time, all threads; null where the JVM can't report it.

peakHeapBytes.description: Sum of each heap pool's own peak usage; an upper bound that can exceed maxHeapBytes, because the pools peak at different moments.

maxHeapBytes.description: The heap limit of the run.

peakRssBytes.description: Peak resident set size (Linux VmHWM); null elsewhere.

inputBytes.description: Bytes of input model files read (ZIP entries not counted).

triplesLoaded.description: Triples parsed from the input models.
